Commit 81d596d9 fix(shell): darker light-theme ink for the phone wordmark and tab labels.U+000AU+002D New FieldNotesColors tokens:U+000A  U+002D accentInkStrong: light #9A4832, dark #E8927A (equal to accentInk).U+000A  U+002D mutedInkStrong: light #6A5C4A, dark #BFAA8E (equal to mutedDeep).U+000A  U+002D Both are added to the constructor, light, dark, copyWith, lerp and _values.U+000AU+002D The phone header wordmark uses accentInkStrong except over the scene. PhoneBottomBar uses accentInkStrong for the selected tab and mutedInkStrong for the others; over-scene inks are unchanged. The calendar's phoneCalendarSmallAccentInk helper from 19d9386f is removed in favour of accentInkStrong.U+000AU+002D Tests:U+000A  U+002D New test/app/shell/phone_chrome_contrast_test.dart applies textContrastGuideline in light and dark over Today, Calendar, Search and Settings, skipping the Meadow. It was red before: wordmark 2.93, selected tab 2.87, unselected tabs 3.95.U+000A  U+002D field_notes_colors_test now lists the tokens and adds a check that the strong light inks reach 4.5:1 on every panel and card colour. The window page colour is excluded: 3.92 and 4.05.U+000A  U+002D bottom_bar_shell_test `_expectedInk` and tour_chapter_test `_expectBarSelection` expect the strong inks.U+000AU+002D tour_chapter_test is in wave 2's onboarding-tour write-set, so expect a possible conflict when shell is merged into mitosis/proto-onboarding.U+000AU+002D Full suite at 81d596d9: analyze clean, 4,220 tests passing. suite-proto-phone-shell.txt is updated.U+000AU+002D Pushed as `git push origin 81d596d9:refs/heads/mitosis/proto-phone-shell`. The LOCAL branch mitosis/proto-phone-shell stays at 19d9386f on purpose, because it is wave 2's --feature-branch while wave 2 runs. After wave 2 exits: fast-forward the local branch to 81d596d9, merge it into each wave 2 branch, resolve conflicts, then run the suites.U+000AU+002D The PR description of #251 predates this commit, and pr.mjs has no edit verb, so the commit message carries the change.U+000AU+002D #251's CI checks (goldens, receipts, pr-title-lint) were pending at 22:35.
